title: [Audit] Security configuration changes
description: Raw security_config_change payloads — API key invalidation, user profile writes, role and privilege edits. The field is a JSON string, shown verbatim.
esql: FROM logs-serverless.audit.otel-elastic_cloud | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.event.action, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change, client.ip | SORT @timestamp DESC
